senses.gloss: बन्धन- + आगार बन्धन- + आगार, a jail, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 17. []
बन्धु- + काम बन्धु- + काम, adj. one who loves his kinsmen, Brāhmaṇ. 1, 23.
† बंह् बंह्, or वंह् वंह् (cf. बृह्), i. 1, Ātm. To grow or increase.
बंहिष्ठ बंहिष्ठ, बंहीयंस् बंहीयंस्, see बहुल.
बन् बन्, see वन्.

बन्ध् बन्ध्, ii. 9, बध्ना, बध्नी, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Chr. 27, 2).
 1. To bind, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 14; with अञ्जलिम्, to put one's hands together, etc. (see अञ्जलि,
 3), Vikr. 58, 12; सेतुना गङ्गाम्, To bridge over the Ganges, MBh. 3, 10727; to overpower, Pañc. i. d. 128; to preclude, Pañc. i. d. 350.
 2. To fasten, Matsyop. 47.
 3. To bind on, MBh. 3, 12066.
 4. To put on, Rām. 2, 37, 12; Ātm., Chr. 27, 2.
 5. To fix on (as the inclination), Man. 5, 47.
 6. To catch, Hit. i. d. 46.
 7. To gain, get, Vikr. d. 27 (धृतिम्, satisfaction).
 8. To bear (as fruit), Ragh. 12, 69.
 9. To punish, Hit. ii. d. 63.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. बद्ध,
 1. Bound.
 2. Fixed, Vikr. 54, 4; firmly rooted, Rājat. 5, 377.
 3. Directed, Pañc. i. d. 350.
 4. Got, Vikr. d. 26.
 5. Inlaid, Megh. 77.
 6. Checked, suppressed, Utt. Rāmac. 125, 1; Daśak. in. Chr. 187, 10.
 7. Withheld.
 --Comp.
 --Comp. ptcple. fut. pass. अ-बध्य, adj. what may not be checked, Pañc. i. d. 413.
 --Caus. बन्धय,
 1. To cause to be bound, endowed, Ragh. 12, 7.
 2. To cause to be embanked, Rājat. 5, 90.
 --i. 10, and † बध् बध्, i. 10, To bind, Rām. 2, 84, 4.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To unite, Rām. 1, 72, 8. []
 2. To hold together, Hit. i. d. 94, M.M.
 3. To set on, Utt. Rāmac. 82, 12 (Premacandra Tark˚, to confound).
 4. To continue, MBh. 3, 2562.
 5. To follow, Śāk. 101, 20. अनुबद्ध,
 1. Bound to.
 2. Connected, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 1 (-अर्थ, adj. Wealthy).
 3. Pressed, Mālav. 44, 14.
 --With अपि अपि, अपिबद्ध, Connected, fastened.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To fasten, Rām. 2, 96, 31.
 2. To put on, Rām. 3, 50, 3. आबद्ध,
 1. Bound on, Kir. 5, 33 (-वेपथु, adj. Trembling).
 2. Joined, Rājat. 5, 92; Daśak. in Chr. 199, 14.
 3. Put on, Megh. 9.
 --With नि नि,
 1. To fasten, Pañc. 135, 5; MBh. 3, 10030; to fix, Vikr. d. 118.
 2. To fetter, Man. 6, 74.
 3. To impose, Vikr. d. 36.
 4. To catch, Pañc. 105, 9; and, To gain, i. d. 18.
 5. To gain, i. d. 18.
 6. To record, Man. 8, 255.
 7. To destroy, MBh. 4, 982. निबद्ध,
 1. Bound, Utt. Rāmac. 143, 2 (covered).
 2. Connected, Man. 4, 155; made, Pañc. 211, 5.
 3. Fixed upon.
 4. Checked.
 5. Restricted.
 --Comp.
 अ-, adj. not called upon as witness, Man. 8, 76 (Kull.).
 --With उपनि उप-नि, उपनिबद्ध, Composed, Utt. Rāmac. 162, 13.
 --With निस् निस्, निर्बद्ध, Pressed hard, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 3.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. निर्बन्धनीय, n. Quarrel(?), Hariv. 7267.
 --With परि परि, परिबद्ध, Obstructed, Rām. 2, 58, 11.
 --With प्र प्र, To bind, Pañc. iii. d. 269. प्रबद्ध, Bound, fastened, Pañc. 89, 10.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To disclaim, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 6.
 2. To obstruct, Ragh. 1, 80 (79).
 3. To enchase, Pañc. i. d. 85. प्रतिबद्ध,
 1. Obstructed.
 2. Opposed.
 3. Set, inlaid, bestudded, Śiś. 9, 8.
 4. Bound, connected with, [] Hit. iii. d. 128.
 --With सम् सम्, संबद्ध,
 1. Connected with.
 2. Endowed with.
 3. Bound.
 --Comp.
 अ-, adj. 1. one who has received no mandate, being without authority, Man. 8, 163. 2. unconnected. 3. incoherent. 4. inept, Śāk. d. 16.
 --With अनुसम् अनु-सम्, अनुसंबद्ध, Accompanied, Johns. Sel. 23, 123.
 --Cf. Goth. and A.S. bindan; A.S. bonda, baend, baest; Goth. fastan; O.H.G. fasti; A.S. faest; Lat. patibulum (cf. रुधिर), pendĕre, pendêre, pondus, etc., probably filum, funis (for fid + lum, fud-nis); mani-festus; πεῖσμα (for πενθ + ματ), πενθερός.

बन्ध बन्ध् + अ, m.
 1. Binding. Pañc. 248, 12; laying (snares), Pañc. 114, 11.
 2. Holding in fetters, Man. 8, 310.
 3. The body.
 4. Building, Rājat. 5, 114.
 5. Forming, 344.
 6. Agreement, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 19; union, Pañc. 60, 19.
 7. A tie, Vikr. d. 85; fetter, knot, Hit. i. d. 49, M.M.
 8. A pledge, a deposit.
 --Comp.

बन्धक बन्ध् + अक,
 I. n.
 1. Binding.
 2. Barter.
 II. m. A pledge.
 III. f. की.
 1. An unchaste woman, Pañc. i. d. 197.
 2. A barren woman.
 3. A she elephant.
 --Comp.

बन्धन बन्ध् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Binding, Pañc. ii. d. 20; Hit. iii. d. 21 (of the ocean, by a bridge), fastening, Hit. i. d. 29, M.M.; catching, Pañc. 114, 6.
 2. Confining, Hit. 34, 3, M.M. (जाल-, by a net).
 3. A prison, Man. 9, 288.
 4. A rope for tying cattle.
 II. m., f. ना or नी, and n. The instrument of tying, holding together, Utt. Rāmac. 40, 12; tic, Pañc. v. d. 19; string, Hit. 77, 1, M.M. (स्नायु-, made of a sinew); a rope, a thread, Pañc. iv. d. 78; a chain, snare, Pañc. ii. d. 19; stem, Utt. Rāmac. 53, 15.
 --Comp.
बन्धमय बन्धमय, see श्लोक-बन्धमय.
ऽबन्धिन् -बन्धिन्, i. e. बन्ध्, and बन्ध + इन्, adj., f. नी, Fettered, Vikr. d. 147. मत्स्य-, m. A fisher, Pañc. 247, 8.

बन्धु बन्ध् + उ, m.
 1. A kinsman, Pañc. iii. d. 182.
 2. Kindred, Man. 2, 136; [] 3, 148 (maternal cousin, Kull.).
 3. A friend, Hit. i. d. 30, M.M.
 --Comp.

बन्धुर बन्धुर (partly vb. बन्ध्),
 I. adj.
 1. Uneven, undulating, Ragh. 13, 47.
 2. Bent, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 23.
 3. Pleasing, handsome, Śāk. d. 140.
 4. Deaf.
 5. Injurious.
 II. m.
 1. A goose.
 2. A crane.
 III. f. रा, A prostitute.
 IV. n.
 1. A diadem.
 2. The dregs of oil.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. वन्धुर and A.S. bendan.

बन्धूर बन्धूर, adj.
 1. Bent.
 2. Handsome (cf. the last).

बन्ध्य बन्ध्य, i. e. बन्ध् + य,
 I. adj., f. या.
 1. Barren, Hit. pr. d. 15, M.M.
 2. Confined.
 II. f. या.
 1. A childless woman.
 2. A barren cow.
 --Comp.
बान्धकिनेय बान्धकिनेय, i. e. बन्धकी + इन् + एय, m. A bastard.

बान्धव बान्धव, i. e. बन्धु + अ, m.
 1. A relation, a kinsman, Pañc. iii. d. 141; [] Hit. i. d. 71, M.M.; Man. 4, 179 (a maternal relation, Kull.).
 2. A friend, Hit. i. d. 72, M.M.
 --Comp.
बन्धु- + वर्ग बन्धु- + वर्ग, m. relations, Pañc. i. d. 30.
बन्धन- + वेश्मन् बन्धन- + वेश्मन्, n. a prison.
बन्धन- + स्थान बन्धन- + स्थान, n. a stable, [] Pañc. 224, 8.
